Colour Theme — applies to all 15 platforms
DevSector Intelligence is a unified gateway to 15 global development data platforms. Every platform uses Global Health's exact layout — same D3 choropleth maps, same Chart.js trend analysis, same filter bar, same 10-theme system.

Built for researchers, policymakers and practitioners who need rapid cross-sector intelligence.
